extensions.provenance: Extracted from src/style.css and src/main.jsx; no UI changes. DM Sans and Newsreader are bundled through @fontsource imports; system fallbacks remain available.

components.name: Guidance field
components.css: .ds-field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;font:11px sans-serif}.ds-field textarea{border:1px solid #b9c5bd;background:white;border-radius:5px;padding:9px;font:12px/1.6 sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#25322f)}.ds-field textarea:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--green,#205b49);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Review tabs
components.css: .ds-tabs{display:flex;gap:15px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#dde2dc)}.ds-tabs button{background:transparent;border:0;border-bottom:2px solid transparent;padding:12px 1px;font:12px sans-serif;color:var(--muted,#65716b)}.ds-tabs button[aria-current]{border-bottom-color:var(--green,#205b49);color:var(--green,#205b49);font-weight:600}.ds-tabs button:hover{background:#edf1ec}.ds-tabs button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--green,#205b49);outline-offset:3px}

components.html: <button class="ds-evidence">“General confidentiality obligations continue for 7 years after termination.”</button>

narrative.overview: Operate mode preserves the agreement as the primary reading surface and keeps assistance close to its evidence. The existing interface is restrained, compact and document-led. This record describes current source code, not a proposed visual redesign or a screenshot reconstruction.
keyCharacteristics: Paper-like agreement surface beside a structured review pane.
Quiet green actions, amber attention and explicit text labels.
Source wording and saved guidance remain visually distinct.
dos: Keep source wording visible while inspecting a finding.
Use text and icons alongside semantic colors.
Preserve explicit mode, scope and stale-review indicators.
donts: Turn a guidance match into a contract-approval indicator.
Replace exact evidence with decorative summary cards.
Hide the current agreement behind a chat-first workflow.
